cards.title: "Can You Just Leave It Here?" | Exyn CEO & COO Ben Williams ($EXYN)
cards.heading: "CAN YOU JUST LEAVE IT HERE?" | EXYN CEO & COO BEN WILLIAMS
cards.desc: What happens when a drone loses GPS, loses its radio link and has no map, deep underground? For Exyn Technologies, that is the starting point. CEO/COO Ben Williams sits down with Benny Shaw and JT Paterson from The Zero Hour Group, joined by Jeff Gabel and World Media White House Bureau Chief Kate Jones.
